panels.title: Error Rate — Errors per Minute (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from product-service per minute. Spikes correlate with Elasticsearch/Neo4j failures, invalid product writes, or Feign call timeouts to order-service.

panels.title: Cache Operation Logs — Hit / Miss Events (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams product-service log lines mentioning cache operations (Redis). High miss volume on product detail lookups indicates the Redis cache is not warm — S2-F12 caching may not be effective.

panels.title: Correlation ID Trace — Cross-Service Request Chains (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams product-service log lines carrying a correlationId. Useful for tracing a single user request through the product→order Feign call chain for language preference enrichment.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Requests/s per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_count | Layer 2 – Label: job=product-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by uri. Reveals which product endpoints (search, detail, sales) are under the most load during peak hours.

panels.title: HTTP Latency Percentiles — P50 / P95 / P99 (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_bucket | Layer 2 – Label: job=product-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: histogram_quantile at 0.50, 0.95, 0.99. P99 latency on GET /api/products/{id}/sales identifies slow Feign enrichment from order-service.

panels.title: Cache Hit / Miss Ratio — Redis Effectiveness (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: cache_gets_total | Layer 2 – Label: job=product-service, result=hit|miss | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by result. Verifies S2-F12 caching is effective — a falling hit ratio means products are not being cached or cache is being evicted prematurely.
